request: Analyze GSE224900 for PMID 37486024 (Disuse-induced muscle fibrosis, cellular senescence, and senescence-associated secretory phenotype in older adults are alleviated during re-ambulation with metformin pre-treatment.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk total RNA-seq (rRNA-depleted), vastus lateralis, older adults (S2.7.p1)
final.primary_estimand: Within-participant change in muscle gene expression with 5 d bed rest (disuse; POST vs PRE) and after 7 d re-ambulation (REC vs PRE), separately in the placebo and metformin arms (S3.4.p1, Fig 5a-d). Physical-activity axis = disuse/reloading, not structured exercise.
final.repeated_measure_unit: participant (biopsies at PRE, DAY1, POST, REC; S2.4.p1)
final.inclusion: fasted biopsies at PRE, POST, REC; N = 9-10/group (Fig 5 legend)
planned_contrasts: Placebo POST vs PRE (S3.4.p1; paper 441 DEGs)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 1.30 via hciR (S2.7.p1); formula not stated
final.paper_results: collagen isoforms highly upregulated in placebo REC (S3.4.p1); CDKN1A, TP53 up in placebo not metformin after bed rest and recovery (S3.5.p1)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.7.p1 gives DESeq2 + 5% FDR, no fold-change rule; S3.4.p1 gives the four within-arm DEG counts vs PRE. The paper's activity manipulation is bed-rest disuse followed by re-ambulation; there is no exercise-training arm, so the activity estimand is disuse/reloading within each arm.

checks: timepoint labels PRE/Day1/POST/7d and Placebo/Metformin match the trial design (S2.3.p1)
10 metformin participants (5F/5M = Table 1) and 9 placebo (paper N=9-10/group)

ownership.reasoning: Both count files (19565R, 20063R sequencing runs) belong to GSE224900 and the paper names it.

final.subject_key: derived in prep_merge.py from consecutive per-participant biopsy blocks; age/sex/treatment constant within each block

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns (19565X1...) equal the first token of title, written as column `key` by prep_merge.py (two count files merged on identical Ensembl IDs). GEO has no participant ID; prep_merge.py assigns `subject` by sample-number blocks that each start at a PREbc biopsy - every block has one age, one sex and one treatment, giving 9 placebo + 10 metformin participants. Clamp (ac) and Day1 biopsies excluded: the paper's DE uses fasted PRE/POST/REC.

matrix.reasoning: All values integer, median 0, max ~1.2e7; data_processing: STAR two-pass alignment to GRCh38/Ensembl 104 with gene counts; paper used DESeq2.

design.subject: subject

final.estimand_type: within-subject change; no non-bed-rest control arm

candidates.reason_rejected: the paper's reported DEG counts are within-arm vs PRE; interaction is the drug question, not the activity estimand
DAY1 reflects 2-wk drug run-in, not disuse; paper's RNA-seq DE uses PRE/POST/REC (S3.4.p1)

design.reasoning: Placebo arm isolates disuse/re-ambulation (primary); metformin arm reproduces the paper's second set but mixes drug exposure with disuse (secondary). Each arm fitted separately as the paper reports per-arm volcano plots.

covariates.name: sex
covariates.disposition: nested within subject; absorbed by subject block (per-sex fits run as exploratory)

covariates.name: run
covariates.disposition: sequencing run nested within subject; absorbed by subject block

covariance.reasoning: Repeated biopsies per participant -> subject block. Sex and sequencing run are constant within subject, so the subject term absorbs them.

deviations: pydeseq2 instead of R DESeq2 1.30/hciR; hciR default filtering and formula not stated in the paper

method.reasoning: Raw counts support the paper's DESeq2 route; one model per arm with all three timepoints and subject blocking.

threshold.reasoning: S2.7.p1: 5% FDR, no fold-change cutoff; Fig 5 legend: adjusted p < 0.05.

caveats: Activity axis is bed-rest disuse and re-ambulation, not exercise training.
No time-matched non-bed-rest control: time contrasts include any time/season effect; metformin-arm contrasts also include drug exposure (POST) or withdrawal (REC).
Participant IDs were derived from sample-number blocks, not given in GEO.

Expression-inferred sex contradicts GEO labels in 7 metformin-arm biopsies: 5 biopsies excluded, one block relabelled F; the metformin arm therefore differs from the paper's sample set (paper presumably used the labels as deposited).

study.reasoning: All four contrasts follow the paper's DESeq2 + FDR 5% route.

discrepancies.data: GEO lacks participant IDs; derived from biopsy blocks (age/sex constant)

XIST/chrY: 19565_S084 block entirely female though GEO says M (label corrected, block kept); single swapped biopsies 19565X81 and 19565X96 excluded; block 19565_S090 switches sex between PREac and Day1, all its PRE/POST/REC biopsies excluded. Metformin arm analysed with 9 participants (PRE 8, POST 8, REC 9).
